title: Scaffold a new FSD feature slice

name.description: Slice name in kebab-case (e.g. "add-to-cart") — becomes <app>/src/features/<name>. Invalid values are refused with a report, not thrown

publicApiName.description: Exported stub function name. Defaults to the camelCase form of name

segments.description: Extra segments to start the slice with, each as <segment>/index.ts (e.g. ui,api). model always exists — it holds the stub. Names are by purpose: ui, api, lib, config … (components/hooks/utils/types are refused)

project.description: The frontend app whose source root holds the FSD layers (run add-fsd-lite first). Omitted: the workspace's one frontend application; with more than one, the run is refused with the candidates listed

locale.description: Generated content language. Defaults to toolkit.config.json's locale, else en

dryRun.description: Print the files that would be generated without writing anything
